title: Descending Everest, Part II: Oracle Complexity of Minimizing a Sum of Convex $(L_0,L_1)$-Smooth Functions
abstract: arXiv:2611.04171v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study the minimization of the average of $n$ convex $(L_0,L_1)$-smooth functions: the Hessian norm of each function is bounded by an affine function of its gradient norm. We assume known upper bounds $R$ on the distance from the starting point to a minimizer and $\delta$ on the difference between the minimum of the average and the average of the infima of the components. We derive upper and lower bounds on the oracle complexity of reaching accuracy $\varepsilon$ in function value in expectation. Up to logarithmic factors, both bounds are of order $n(1+(L_1R)^{2/3}) +\sqrt{\frac{n(L_0+L_1^2\delta)R^2}{\varepsilon}+n(L_1R)^2}$. The upper bound is attained by the proposed method YETI. The method combines ideas of accelerated proximal methods and variance reduction methods with a heuristic for choosing additional points. translated_title: 下珠穆朗玛峰（第二部分）：最小化凸 $(L_0,L_1)$-光滑函数之和的预言机复杂度
translated_abstract: 我们研究 $n$ 个凸 $(L_0,L_1)$-光滑函数平均值的最小化问题，其中每个函数的 Hessian 范数被其梯度范数的仿射函数所界定。我们假设已知从起点到某个极小值点距离的上界 $R$，以及平均函数的最小值与各分量函数下确界的平均值之差的上界 $\delta$。我们推导了在期望意义下函数值达到精度 $\varepsilon$ 所需的预言机复杂度的上界与下界。在对数因子范围内，两个界均为 $n(1+(L_1R)^{2/3}) +\sqrt{\frac{n(L_0+L_1^2\delta)R^2}{\varepsilon}+n(L_1R)^2}$ 阶。该上界由所提出的方法 YETI 达到。该方法将加速近端方法与方差缩减方法的思想相结合，并引入了一种选择附加点的启发式策略。该启发式策略的预言机调用次数是有界的，从而保证了总预言机调用次数的上界仍然成立。
tldr: 提出了结合加速近端方法、方差缩减与有界启发式选点策略的 YETI 方法，并给出了最小化凸 $(L_0,L_1)$-光滑函数之和的预言机复杂度的匹配上界与下界（相差对数因子）。
en_tdlr: Proposes YETI—combining accelerated proximal methods, variance reduction, and a bounded heuristic for selecting extra points—to attain matching (up to logarithmic factors) upper and lower bounds on the oracle complexity of minimizing the average of convex $(L_0,L_1)$-smooth functions.
